svg.title: cost-optimisation-terraform
svg.desc: Scheduled stop/start of tagged EC2 and RDS via EventBridge + Lambda; IAM scoped to the tag. AWS Budgets and anomaly alerts over SNS. Tech: Lambda, EventBridge, Budgets, pytest + moto, tf test.
